instruction: Fix `dedupe` so it keeps the first occurrence of each key (it currently keeps the duplicates instead).
gold_patch:
diff --git a/datastore.py b/datastore.py
--- a/datastore.py
+++ b/datastore.py
@@ -51,7 +51,7 @@
     seen = set()
     out = []
     for r in records:
-        if r[key] in seen:
+        if r[key] not in seen:
             out.append(r)
         seen.add(r[key])
     return out
